column1: # One row per fuzz run that tools/fuzz/run (make fuzz) appended: DATE, when the run started, in UTC; COMMIT, the checkout's HEAD, with -dirty when a file other than a runs.tsv differed from it or was new and not ignored; TARGET, the fuzz target; SECONDS, how long libFuzzer ran, as libFuzzer counts it when the run ends on time and as the wall clock measures it when the run stops early; RUNS, how many inputs libFuzzer ran; CORPUS, how many inputs its corpus held at the end; COV, the code coverage libFuzzer reports as cov, the number of edges the inputs reached; RESULT, ok, or the kind of failure (crash, timeout, oom or leak) and the path of the input that caused it, or failed with libFuzzer's exit status when it left no input; HOST, the machine's architecture (uname -m) and its CPU count (nproc). A - marks a figure the run did not record.
